goal: a surfer rule on the zig-zag lattice that keeps |psi|^2 EXACTLY (machine precision) with the least randomness

schemes.flow: S4 NEW: deterministic flow in flow time (Pollock / lowest-order Raviart-Thomas) of the NET link flux of the tick
schemes.flow2: S4 over the two-tick period of the 3-D rule (x,y,z then z,y,x): net flux of the pair, rho(2m) -> rho(2m+2)
schemes.bellflux: S2b: Bell continuous-time jumps with rates F+/rho(s) (net flux of the tick, flow time), exact master equation
schemes.bell: S2: Bell minimal discrete jumps per sub-step (pre_core lambda = 0)
schemes.ballistic: S1: Bell gross-flow jumps per sub-step (pre_core lambda = 1): every surfer moves like the walk
schemes.cdfasse: S3: monotone CDF map along lines per sub-step (IDEE_RIPRESE R3)
schemes.old: S0: Rust zz.rs reader (trilinear spinor at the tick boundary, Bohm-Dirac v, midpoint) - not equivariant
schemes.old_rebirth: S0 + 0.2 % of surfers reborn from |psi|^2 every tick (as zzscena.rs: 40 of 20000)
schemes.proiettato: S5 (orbitals, continuous time): Dirac current at faces + minimal Poisson correction -> exact flux -> S4

discrete_choices: net (minimal) flux instead of gross flows
aggregation period (1 tick; 2 ticks for flow2)
RT0 field inside a cell (each component linear in its own coordinate)
rho(s) linear in time inside the tick
S5 only: Poisson (L2-minimal) correction of the face current

E0a.what: Walk3D with flux == zz_core.Walk; rho1 = rho0 - div F

E0b.what: Liouville over one tick on the 3-D production states (finite differences h = 1e-6)

E0c.what: reversibility of S4: 20 ticks forward then 20 back (with -F), cells

E1.what: old F6 test: 1-D free walk theta = 0.1, R-Gaussian sigma = 5, 40 hbar/mc^2, 2000 surfers; max quantile error
E1.report: old reader (expected ~1.26e-2 as in ZIGZAG F6b)

E2.what: continuum limit 1-D: max_u |Q_lattice - Q_continuum| over t <= 40 for a = theta = 0.2, 0.1, 0.05
E2.report: Bell (S2b) rms distance from S4 at t = 40 vs a (Vink: expected to shrink)

E3.what: hydrogen Z = 1 (alpha) 1s of the radial rule, a = 0.5, 1e4 ticks, 2e4 surfers: stationary real state

E4.what: radial Z = 60, a = 0.05, (1s + 2s)/sqrt2, 20 beat periods: equivariance

E5.what: 3-D zig-zag atom Z = 60, n = 48, a = 0.5 (the live atom of zz.rs), listened 1s, 1000 ticks
E5.note: continuum Bohm-Dirac for the exact 1s: v_phi = Z alpha c sin(theta), v_r = 0

E7.what: 3-D free packet (sigma = 3, k = (0.6, 0.3, 0), theta = 0.5, periodic 48^3), 300 ticks

E8.what: fake mixing (c): random bits / jumps per surfer per tick, decorrelation of r, relaxation of a |psi|^4 start in states where continuum de Broglie-Bohm does NOT mix (radial beat: 1-D order frozen; 3-D 1s: r conserved)

E9.what: analytic orbitals (as orbitali.rs): 1s + 2p1/2 continuous time on 48^3 at a = 0.5, dt = period/200, 2000 steps
E9.report: old orbital reader with and without 0.5 %/step rebirth

statistics.chi2: surfer histogram vs |psi|^2 on 2^3 blocks (3-D) / 4 or 8 cells (radial), bins with expected < 5 merged; z = (chi2 - dof)/sqrt(2 dof); 41 checkpoints per run
statistics.tv: total variation distance divided by the mean TV of an ideal iid sampler of the same N
